column1: # Medical English -> Arabic glossary (Modern Standard Arabic clinical usage).
# Loaded with serve_session.py --glossary glossaries/medical.tsv. Each term is
# lifted out before translation and put back after; see src/lad_translate/glossary.py.
# Acronyms map to their Arabic clinical names rather than staying in Latin:
# the Arabic voice reads Latin letters as noise ("HbA1c" came back as
# "habai wahid"). Drug names are transliterated for the same reason.
# NOT YET REVIEWED by an Arabic-speaking clinician. Several entries overlap the
# answer key in the Medical Translation Test Script, so glossary hits on that
# script are no longer an independent score.
